CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, July 15, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 17, 2026 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  “PRIDE OF ALHAMBRA” UTILITY BOX ART PROPOSAL

  V.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  July 15, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, June 17, 2026
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:00 P.M. on Wednesday June 17, 2026 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall, 111
South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Hermano.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Love and Commission Member Navarro.
Staff Present: Deputy Director Houghton

APPROVAL OF THE MAY 20, 2026 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano
the May 20, 2026 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
Commissioner Hermano shared recycled stained-glass kinetic sculpture renderings by Loretta
Contreras and ExpandLifeMetal, Vice President Saunders shared peace poles research and
President Canseco will provide a kinetic sculpture quote at the next Alhambra City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission meeting. Deputy Director Houghton requested the Alhambra City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission to send their public art quotes and recommended artist’s
contact information to Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra for creation of a shared log and stated
that the Alhambra Community Center public art will be installed on a pedestal; site specifications
will be shared at a later date.

PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL: 110 SOUTH CHAPEL AVENUE
The 110 South Chapel Avenue public art proposal was unanimously approved with the addition
of a pedestal of at least 16-18 inches height and a final rendering submitted to the Alhambra City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton announced an Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery “Call for
Artists” social media blast will be released this year and requested the Alhambra City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission to network with local artists for 2027 exhibitions. A poll of
potential 2027 Alhambra Tournament of Roses Float titles will be e-mailed to the Alhambra City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission and after review, their preferred title selected. The
proposed “Faces of Welcome” contest has been set aside at this time as the Alhambra City
Council expressed interest in riding the 2027 Alhambra Tournament of Roses Float.
 Deputy Director Houghton invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and
their families to attend the 4th of July Celebration at Almansor Park on Saturday July 4, 2026 and
upcoming Concerts and Movies in the Park at the Alhambra Park Bandshell in July.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
No committee communication occurred.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Commission Member Hermano, the June 17,
2026 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:22 P.M.
